d:
Experience the divine power and grace with the Ganpati Aarti song sung by the legendary Amitabh Bachchan in the movie "Sarkar 3." This sacred Aarti pays homage to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles and the harbinger of good fortune.
Credits:
Song Name: Ganpati Aarti
Vocals: Amitabh Bachchan
Composer: Rohan Vinayak
Lyricist: Traditional
Director: Ram Gopal Varma
Cast: Amitabh Bachchan
